main_text.l: Horum enim decem nominum quę Goliatho
attributa sunt, nullum est quod nó ab reliquis
omnibus categoria & genere difcrepet. ut nec
in illo: Hector, vir magnus, fortis, bellator, pu-
gnans, interfectus ad Troiam ętate[?] occubuit
chlamydatus.
CAP. XXIX.
Q[?]VID? Nónne Categoriæ sunt or-
do rerum omnium per genera, spe-
cies & differentias compositus? Ca-
tegoriarum disciplina, neque ad
res, néque ad rerum ordinem describendum
pertinet: quemadmodum vulgò in scholis tra-
ditur. sed ad dictiones tantum, & attributio-
nes, & vocabula: ut eorum summa genera illis
tanquam certis notis cognosci possint. quo-
niam (ut superius ex Aristotele docuimus)
quicquid de alio dicitur id ex aliqua Catego-
ria sumi, eíque attribui oportet. τὸ ͵ ὑπάρχειν τόδε τισὶ, ἢ τὸ ἀληθεύεσθαι τόδε κατά τῶν τόδε,
τοσαυταχῶς λεγέον, ὅσαχῶς αἱ κατηγορίαι διήρηνται[?]. lib. prior. Analyt. 1. cap. 26. Caput autem Dialecticę
artis est, ut qua ratione aliud de alio dici &
pronunciari possit, demonstret. Itaque dictio-
num declinatione Categorias immutari con-
stat: cùm tamen ob inflexionem verbi res non
immutetur. veluti Iustus, est substantia. Iusti-
tia, est qualitas. Eques substantia est, Equita-
{Equita-} tus

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of "QVID?" is ornamental; the letter is read as Q with [?]. The Greek sentence is printed small and partly worn; its wording after "τόδε" and the final word are uncertain and are marked [?]. The word after "ętate" is marked [?]. The catchword "tus" completes the broken word "Equitatus". The foot line is a duplicate of the catchword and should be ignored: it is not printed text, so the bottom catchword alone is the correct entry. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised. Printed page number 100 at top left; running head DIALECTICAE.
